title: Shipped
headline: A week spent making the tools prove what they claim, rather than report it.
standfirst: The largest single piece of work was a ground-up rewrite of the résumé generator. The most consequential were three separate fixes to tools that had been quietly reporting success they had not earned.

The through-line was verification. A release tool that could tag the wrong version. A publisher that called a page live before it was reachable. An issue-to-pull-request flow that ran for nearly an hour and never touched the tracker at all. Each was found by running the thing and measuring it, not by reviewing it.

items.title: A claim with no artifact behind it
items.text: This sentence reads exactly like the true ones above it.
